notes: doNotOptimize and --bench-gc are 'added: REPLACEME' (unreleased) on main. Examples feature-detect them instead of using a made-up version.
discrepancies: bench.md:765-800 context.end([operations]) and context.record({operations}) document operations as optional (Default: 1) with no changes: entry; v26.13.0 requires it (ERR_INVALID_ARG_TYPE 'The "operations" argument must be of type number').
bench.md:390 bench() `gc` option has no changes: entry; v26.13.0 silently ignores it (plan has no gc field, no --expose-gc error), main honors it.
bench.md:292-310 (reporters environment snapshot) has no version marker; v26.13.0 json reporter emits no 'bench:environment' record and spec prints no environment header; main does.
